what: A transform field on the oracle's Design tab, and the same field in Animation and on Corner: measured on a new Shape on the probe page with real mouse input.

input.text: one text value with its unit

values.overflow: 2,000px runs under the letter, as on the oracle

letter.where: pair fields only, always shown, in a 22 by 28 box at 55,8

arrows.where: single fields and Timing fields; not Corner, not pairs
arrows.shown: opacity 0 idle, 1 on hover anywhere on the field and on focus

reset.glyph: white cross in a 22 by 22 box at -3,-3
reset.shown: only with focus or in a drag, and only off the default
reset.notOn: Anchor's X and Y: its Reset stays opacity 0 at 58%

focus.ring: outline 2px solid rgb(14, 14, 14), outside the box
focus.caret: Enter keeps focus, caret at the end: 30° at 3,3
focus.hitsStay: the edge hits keep their place on focus

drag.rule: 0.4 per pixel. 20 px gives 8 on Rotate, Scale, Offset, Skew and Corner

bar.rule: left = (f - 1) * width, f = (value - low) / (high - low), held to 0..1; shown only during a drag
bar.inferred: The ranges for Scale, Offset, Skew and Corner are what fits these reads, and no read lands on an end except the held ones.

timing.drag: 0.5s + 20 px = 1.3s; no bar, the <> and a Reset as on the others

corner.element: the parent of the label's text

notBuilt: The panel moves on our side when a transform changes the block's rect, as Offset 2000 does: placeBlockPanel reads the transformed rect. The oracle's panel stays. Named, placement is the fixes lane's.
unread: Dragging past a bar range's end on Scale, Offset and Skew: the value's own limit there.
Timing fields beyond Duration: Delay and the rest share its code.
Thousands commas on Animation's fields: read on Transforms only, ours shows Animation's with none.
Undo with the focus left in a field after a drag: ours leaves the field, then undoes.
